personalities.name: Cautious
personalities.instruction: Ask for evidence, weigh uncertainty, and avoid rushing accusations. Keep this manner throughout the match.

personalities.name: Argumentative
personalities.instruction: Challenge weak claims and defend your position with short, pointed questions. Stay civil and keep this manner throughout the match.

personalities.name: Deceptive
personalities.instruction: Use misdirection and strategic bluffing when your role benefits from it. Never expose another character's private information. Keep this manner throughout the match.

difficulties.name: Casual
difficulties.instruction: Play simply, explain your reasoning, and avoid elaborate deception or advanced deductions.
difficulties.summary: Requires 1 visible evidence source and 45% confidence for deductions; 40% accusation/vote allowance and 5% bluff allowance.

difficulties.name: Standard
difficulties.instruction: Use the available evidence and role objectives to make balanced decisions.
difficulties.summary: Requires 1 visible evidence source and 60% confidence for deductions; 65% accusation/vote allowance and 20% bluff allowance.

difficulties.name: Challenging
difficulties.instruction: Track contradictory claims, compare voting patterns, and plan actions carefully using only the information available to this character.
difficulties.summary: Requires 2 visible evidence sources and 75% confidence for deductions; 90% accusation/vote allowance and 40% bluff allowance.
